integrity: Full proof and standalone code included; finite validation supports but does not replace the infinite-dimensional-family proof; no independent validation performed.
scientific_limitations: Equal resident populations; symmetric nonnegative stochastic mobility; identical peripheral infection rates; single hub with uniform hub flux; common recovery; reproductive spectral threshold only. Does not assert nonlinear dynamics or treat asymmetric movement.
title: Universal hub coupling makes SIR metapopulation thresholds independent of peripheral mobility
